meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抛出研究问题，得到带引用、经质检的调研报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对某个问题做系统调研并要可核实的引用来源。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, QA-checked report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic investigation with verifiable citations.

howto.what: 你明确要求研究时，Claude 会自己拆解课题、组建多名成员的研究团队分头收集来源，对争议结论做辩论并用代码验证，最后交付一份每条论断都带引用或验证证明的报告。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求时触发：说出 “ulw-research”、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞，或明确要求研究、深度调研等；普通提问和调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我深挖这个话题
对这个问题做一次 ultradebate 研究，线索查尽为止
say.note: 有争议的结论会被送去辩论攻击

say.text: 把研究发现整理成一份带引用的报告，格式你定
say.note: 不等格式答复就开始收集，采用默认格式

howto.what_en: When you explicitly ask for research, Claude splits the topic into axes, stands up a cooperating team to collect sources, debates contested claims, proves some by running code, and delivers a report where every claim has a citation or verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit request: "ulw-research" or any "ulw" research wording, an "ultradebate" request, or a clear ask for research or deep investigation. Ordinary questions do not.

say_en.note: Prints ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED! and builds the team first

say_en.text: Do an ultradebate research run on this question
say_en.note: Contested claims get attacked in debate rounds

say_en.text: Turn the findings into a report; you pick the format
say_en.note: Collection starts without waiting on format answers
